title: Fix Cad Protocol Schema Imports
description: CAD protocol wasm bridge missing CAD_DOCUMENT_SCHEMA and empty_cad_projection imports; fix and get bun ./script.ts dev cad working.
summary: Imported CAD_DOCUMENT_SCHEMA and empty_cad_projection into cad protocol; made protocol rlib-only so wasip2 plugin builds no longer link a protocol cdylib without the bundle installer shim. CAD playground up at :6020.
